◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
a soft green glow under the water
